name: Verdan the Everliving
summary: Verdan the Everliving is a colossal bog beast lurking deep within the verdant tunnels of the Wailing Caverns. He dwells amid the nightmare spreading from the sleeping druid Naralex, alongside the corrupted Druids of the Fang, and violently attacks any who venture into his damp hollows.

sections.title: Beast of the Lush Depths
sections.body: Verdan is a hulking bog beast, an elemental of foliage, silt, and mire that lurks in the overgrown depths of the Wailing Caverns. Nothing is known of him from before the caverns fell to corruption; he is simply the largest and most dangerous creature in their lush, flooded hollows.

sections.title: Twisted by the Nightmare
sections.body: When Naralex attempted to cultivate the dry Barrens into a lush paradise, his ritual fractured into a vivid nightmare within the Emerald Dream. The resulting corruption bled through the subterranean waters, tainting everything living inside the cavern. Amid that blight, Verdan roams as an enormous, hostile brute in the depths shared with the mad Druids of the Fang.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Verdan?
faq.answer: Verdan is a massive bog beast, an elemental being animated out of plant matter, peat, and subterranean mire.

faq.q: Why is Verdan hostile to adventurers?
faq.answer: Verdan lurks in the nightmare-tainted depths of the Wailing Caverns, where the dream of the slumbering Naralex has turned everything hostile. He treats all outside intruders as trespassers to be crushed.

faq.q: What is Verdan's connection to the Druids of the Fang?
faq.answer: Verdan shares the nightmare-tainted caverns with the insane Druids of the Fang and is just as hostile to intruders, guarding the deeper reaches of the caverns.

faq.q: Where in the Wailing Caverns is Verdan located?
faq.answer: Verdan dwells in a cavernous, mossy chamber deep in the winding paths of the Wailing Caverns, past several of the corrupted Fang leaders.

faq.q: Can Verdan be cured or cleansed?
faq.answer: There is no known way to cleanse Verdan, leaving adventurers no choice but to destroy the hulking beast to ensure safe passage through the cavern.
The origin of his epithet is unknown. Verdan is a bog beast of the Wailing Caverns' lush, overgrown depths.

angles.text: Verdan's lair is a grim reminder of what grows in the caverns when the Emerald Dream turns to nightmare.
As an elemental spirit of earth and water grown warped and violent, putting down Verdan is an act of restoring balance to the fractured elements of the Barrens.
Because the Wailing Caverns sit at the heart of the Barrens, defeating dangerous beasts like Verdan is essential to protecting nearby crossroads and settlements.
